captured_note: The inventory (docs/INVENTORY.md) classifies Franca as submodule+patch, Apache. The 9984B patch is for the capture's Step 2 (from-scratch SSL pretraining), which is excluded like every method's step 2. The portable part is the capture's Step 1: a frozen pretrained-backbone linear probe (methods/36_franca/README.md: 'analogous to DINOv2 ... not local Franca pretraining'). The frozen forward has no hardcoded device, so this port pins the upstream DIRECTLY with no fork.
note: The model is the pinned upstream under third_party/franca, imported and never copied (DESIGN section 1). This is an EVAL-ONLY port: it has only a linear_eval stage and no step 1. In the capture, Franca's 'Step 1' is a frozen-backbone linear probe and its 'Step 2' is the from-scratch SSL pretraining (DINO/iBOT/Sinkhorn/KoLeo, H100-class), excluded here. The port trains nothing and produces no encoder.pt; it probes the frozen backbone.
linear_eval: Probes Franca's pretrained ViT-B/14 CLS token (forward_features(x)['x_norm_clstoken']), frozen. Unlike var's tokeniser probe, this is a genuine SSL representation, so the number is comparable (the capture's 'Step 1 caveat / pretrained-backbone reuse' row, analogous to DINOv2). A real run needs the official checkpoint (backbone_artifact below, fetched and hash-verified by bin/fetch-weights.py, passed as the config's train.ckpt); the hermetic smoke leaves ckpt empty and builds a random backbone (pretrained=False), so nothing is downloaded and only the pipeline is exercised. See docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md.

backbone_artifact.name: Franca ViT-B/14 In21K backbone
backbone_artifact.sha256_source: measured on 2026-08-05 by a full download from the GitHub release; bin/fetch-weights.py re-verifies this value on download

rewritten_during_the_port: the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA
features are extracted in fp32; the capture used a bfloat16 autocast, a GPU speed path with no meaningful effect on a frozen-feature linear probe and not portable to a CPU or a pre-Ampere GPU
RASA is disabled (use_rasa_head=False); the capture README notes the official RASA loader mismatches ViT-B/14, and the CLS probe does not use it
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the four comparable linear-probe accuracies and the epoch count
